title: Don’t Let These Financial Headlines Frighten You | Dimensional
gist: Episode 62 of Dimensional's The Informed Investor podcast argues that frightening financial headlines are built to grab attention rather than deliver investment advice. The page carries only a teaser and key takeaways, no detailed data.

insights.claim: Dimensional Fund Advisors argues that scary financial headlines are designed to capture attention, not to give investment advice, so investors should not trade on them.
insights.speaker: Dimensional Fund Advisors
insights.so_what: Treat headline-driven fear as noise; the firm's pitch is to stay with a long-term allocation rather than react.
insights.quote: Headlines are designed to grab attention, not deliver advice.

insights.claim: The podcast episode is tagged to equity investing, fixed income investing and market volatility, framing the headline-fear message as relevant across both asset classes.
insights.speaker: Dimensional Fund Advisors
insights.so_what: Little substance here beyond the firm's standard behavioural-discipline messaging; low signal for trading.

source_meta.author: Featuring Mark Gochnour, Head of Global Client Services Group
